area: Airport Drive and Olive Drive area, north Bakersfield
summary: A high-speed chase that began after officers tried to stop a wanted subject ran north along Airport Drive at speeds up to 91 mph, with an air unit and K9 available. The pursuit ended in a major-injury crash near Airport and Olive drives where crews performed CPR. Officers had called for spike strips as the driver turned onto North Chester Avenue.

area: Pozo Creek area near Highway 155, eastern Kern County
summary: A brush fire burning near Pozo Creek and the Granite area drew a large county assignment, including engines, a strike team and a type-2 helicopter. Crews reached the flames over rough country by way of ranch gates and dirt roads, with the fire reported at roughly 15 to 20 acres.

agency: Kern County Fire Department / law enforcement
area: Acres Road and Barbara Avenue area
summary: Emergency medical units were sent to stage for a reported gunshot wound at the intersection of Acres Road and Barbara Avenue. Officers and medics positioned nearby as the call developed.

area: White Lane, between Monitor and Union avenues
summary: A collision between a vehicle and a bicycle was reported on White Lane between Monitor and Union avenues. Units responded.
After a utility pole was reported de-energized, authorities said people have been cutting down poles in the area to pull copper wire from them.

area: parking lot on Colony Drive, Oildale area
summary: A car meet of roughly 30 vehicles drew a response after several began performing maneuvers in a shopping center parking lot. Units cleared the gathering.
A panic alarm at a home was triggered by a resident reporting a man outside, and officers also checked the area for a man in a black shirt seen nearby. It was unknown if the two were related.
A domestic dispute escalated when a caller said her sister-in-law's ex-boyfriend would not let her leave. Officers responded to the residence.
